contentList.content: I didn't abandon you. But I do have a life beyond Waterdeep - a life worth having.
But that can wait for now - come on, tell me everything. What have you been up to?
It does.
*Perhaps there you might learn how much time has passed since you last graced the planes as a mortal man.*
Farewell, Lae'zel. May the dark lady guide your blade.
*The corpse jerks and gasps lifelessly.*
I can't imagine what they'd do to someone threatening to cure them. But I'm sure you can do that without my help as well.
You're mine to take from, Gortash. I am going to pillage you for all you're worth.
I have been forging my own path, away from Shar's influence.
Breathe deeply and take in the scents around you.
Jug of Water
I am sorry, Lae'zel, but I must decline.
Change the subject.
Just that. Off you go.
When this day comes, you must come and bunk with Minsc and Boo!
Your choices brought you here. Accept your fate and succumb to ceremorphosis.
I'll only be there until we can fix Karlach's heart. Then I promise I'll be back.
Carries an owlbear's egg. Its scent will attract the egg's parents.
That thing's no more than a shadow of the real man. A nonsense. Though it captures some of his more insufferable qualities...
You should know that better than anyone.
Six months later
Exactly the reaction I expected.
Good luck, Gale. Don't forget me when you're a god.
There is more to you than I recognised at first, young Ravengard.
Alas, no. Since we lost our tadpoles, I'm just another vampire spawn.
Red
It was simply a misunderstanding.
To Baldur's Gate!
Say no more. There's a wizard in Blackstaff's anatomical department who owes me a favour, no questions asked. All diets will be catered for. I can hardly wait.
Report User
It is not for me to deny you - enjoy yourself while you can. My Lady shall come to collect, in the end.
The queen has entrusted me with the Prism. Interfere, and death will be her reward to you.
Sorry, Halsin, I was hoping this would just be between us three.
'Angleiron's Smithy'
I'll find you once I'm done here. We can be together again - if you'd like?
I suppose the world is your buffet now - just be careful not to overindulge on innocent young necks, or you may find a mob after you.
As do I. Some would think it impossible to challenge the githyanki lich-queen, but I know you are equal to it.
I'm glad you're happy.
Inner peace suits me, I suppose.
Best Boy in the Realms
Have it your way, then.
His actual nose must be a distant memory by now...
I suppose life has been a little less interesting since we all went our separate ways...
*And what part do you mean to play? Will Lae'zel of K'liir wield a blade in the name of Mother Gith's son - or will she take up new causes, pursue different dreams?*
Perhaps we might creep on, Boo - and pick the very power from his pocket!
Letter from Alfira
Still as charismatic as ever, I'd hasten to add.
A pity, I rather enjoyed our time together. Treasured it, even.
Of course, but I'm afraid I'd be a two-for-one deal. My patron won't be able to resist the thought of a captive audience...
I'm amazed at how quickly you recovered from losing your warlock powers.
Then you'll be able to look out for each other.
Excellent. I knew you wouldn't be able to resist the allure of sharing your expertise.
Stuffed Baby Beholder
What has become of the egg, Lae'zel? Has it hatched?
I appreciate your concern for the city's defence, Lae'zel - but you are worth more than one soldier and more than ten Fists.
Party Invitation Received
Oh, before you go. How does a red dragon plan their day?
To the hope of more adventures to come!
Where have you been causing trouble since I last saw you?
Bhaal's Edict
Gondians No More - Wulbren Bongle's Ironhand Gnomes Take Centre Stage!
*For too long, you allowed yourself to be defined by your faith - but no more. You shall not bow, or pray, or do anything that is not your choice. So choose.*
*The Absolute lies broken at your feet. The first god to fall - but not, perhaps, the last.*
I'm glad the months have not been wasted. Particularly as I spent them cleaning up the mess we made of the city.
So, say a certain barbarian wished to found the most powerful clan in Faerûn. You could help with that?
So long as you don't try to convert me - or worse.
We have detected a mismatch between the following mods and your host's mods. Please review them and take the required actions before continuing.
Can't believe you really did it. Ascended. Wouldn't have picked that for you myself, but at least you look good.
This projected form is adequate. Unless you missed my scent, istik?
Well, you always did like the sound of your own voice.
Your tressym is called Tara and she dislikes your beard. She is wrong - it is a fine beard. Dashing, even.
I think he'll make an excellent addition to the pantheon.
I've spread my wings since we last met. Got a few more spells in my arsenal, a few more miles under my boots...
Wait - you have children?
'Home.' How I love to share that word with you.
*You cede control. It's almost comforting, to be part of something far grander than any individual. You are the crest of a great wave that will consume all, and redefine all.*
Speak to the Wyrmway's central statue.
Who cares? Give me a bloody hug.
I am the Blade of Frontiers!
Quite a gathering - I hope you've saved a spot for me.
Flying across the cosmos on the backs of dragons, waging war on your mad queen - I couldn't be more proud.
Not Connected
Office
If I can't resurrect you, then why are you here?
Are you sure? I know I ended things rather... abruptly.
Vogue
I spoke to Ulma, the leader of those monster hunters. She wants us to save their children from Cazador.
I'm just so glad you're doing all right. I've thought of you often, whenever I could spare half a thought. Surviving Avernus doesn't leave you much time to think.
I just hope the children get by without me there for their bedtime stories...
*The creature approaches. This ground is forbidden to your kind.*
We can be honest with each other, Gale - one immortal being to another: this is great.
Provides an optimised balance of performance and image quality.
Were I to take a lover from the Faerûnian pantheon, I assure you it would not be the runt of the litter.
Ooffh, that's quite a squeeze you put on me, Halsin.
Oh, I am well aware, trust me. Now I've taken up enough of your time - go on, enjoy the festivities.
Lorroakan's pride took a beating, to learn his prize was beyond reach.
The question is - do you wish to go with me? To become a god at my side?
There must be something you can do?
Your troubles have been many. But Boo believes choppy seas make a skilled swimmer especially when you have a paddle-mate at your side!
No! I did not intend a fatal blow!
And it is only your ascension to godhood that makes you so. As a mortal, you were scarcely fit to look at me.
And you, Minthara? Can I be happy for you?
Well, I for one can't wait. And I say with some confidence - neither can they.
I'll make sure they don't fall in with the wrong sort. No taverns, no brothels, and no cults.
Letter from Naaber
We shall aid you, friend vampire. Tonight for the dancing and the dining, and tomorrow for the dark lord's just desserts.
Envisioned and created by a tailor of considerable talents. To wear it is to make one the envy of both friend and enemy.
I am Lae'zel of K'liir. You will let me pass.
No respect for the co-saviour of Faerûn, huh?
Father, no. Curse the Absolute!
Perhaps you can give me more than advice - help me to run the Cloister.
Avernus is my hunting ground now - I've been putting my infernal powers to good use there.
But Lae'zel was, perhaps, greater than the rest.
Aegis of the Absolute: Radiant
Those runes on the floor - the vampire lord feeds on his spawn like a leech.
I can see why I loved you.
I've devoted myself to the hunt. The Sword Coast must be cleansed of its monsters.
Fine - let's just go.
Standing Torch
Understandable. First a goblin, then a ghast, then a gorgon. One victory becomes ten becomes a hundred.
Then this is your home, whatever regrets you might have.
One hug is never enough, is it?
Provides a performance gain to the visible detriment of image quality. Only select this if additional performance is critical.
A pity that you let the real blessing slip through your fingers, of course. Though we all make mistakes.
We could have had victory. We could have had each other. Instead you have chosen madness.
Pull your warlock's enemy towards you.
Bonecloak's Potions
Ramazith's Tower
He could stand to be a little less... cryptic, perhaps.
He's doing well. The rebuilding of Baldur's Gate continues apace.
When Vlaakith is deposed at last, I'm coming home to you. You have my word.
Speak the Rite of Ascension. Vlaakith, ik sa'ith. Vlaakith, tri na'sa'zhi!
But it's more than that to me. It's my domain, and I think in your case I'll bend the rules and make things a little more interesting for both of us.
You can't do this!
My people are the ones I chose. They are here, on Faerûn.
That you've learned a trick or two from me? Steal the gold from their palms and they'll believe you soon enough.
Oh. Oh gods.
I've missed you, man. Like, I've really missed you. And you're so... I don't know. Yourself.
My hamster thought you might stray from the path, but Minsc always bets upon his friends. Keep it up, and Boo will have ne'er a coin left in his little cheeks!
Tell him of how you lost your horn.
I was searching for a way to walk in the sun again. No luck yet, but I won't give up.
Tempting, but you make a better ambassador for us than I do. I'll keep skulking here - I do it well, after all.
You have a mechanic for your heart?
Thirteen kith'raki, twenty-five sarths, and three-hundred-five warriors. Precisely.
Tara, we've been through this. I'm here to be part of your life with Gale, not take him away from you.
Kill with one last kiss.
I trust you're still very glad you chose to live in Hell rather than come home to me and your loving mother?
I suppose to you, mortals are meant only to worship and obey. What other role might they possibly play in the life of a god?
*As soon as it tries to pass through your lips, you feel violently ill.*
All well and good, but what about you? I want to hear what you've been up to.
I did not escape Bhaal's influence to become a monster of my own free will.
I don't think about my blood any more. I actually think I haven't killed a single person since we last met.
I'm glad father's left us to our own devices, more or less - though he's got no shortage of advice when I ask for it.
Would you like a scratch, Tara?

True. I wonder if anyone will be interested to hear the stories they told me of my youngest years. It's still strange to think of this whole other childhood I had before Shar. Almost like it's some other little girl...
Astarion: one of the good guys. Who would've thought?
Go on then - convince me. Why is illusory magic so much fun?
Oh yes? Good for you. I'm sure it's been very emotional and... good.
Survivalist
Some of us need to do rather more than oil our tentacles before a public outing, my dear.
With a few exceptions, Florrick's pardoned every last Fist. 'I will not make them drink the poison of my own resentment.' Her words, not mine.
Hmm. We'll see.
They seem happy, really.
My current plan is to get in, grab a smith, and force him to fix old rusty - or maybe give me a brand new model that can live outside Avernus.
It was on Faerûn that you learned how to be free. This is your home now.
I'm never more than a prayer away, should you need me. I'm sure we'll manage.
Murderous Retort
I love you. Don't ever forget that.
Ha! I am honoured to be your beast of burden, then.
Mother Superior of the Cloister of Sombre Embrace
Last Holdout Cultists Cleared From Temple of Bhaal
Only a joke. Bhaal-me would have been salivating by now.
*You are the end. The last creature living, with all else felled by your hand. Alone, amidst their gall, at the close of eternity.*
Standing here now I no longer see the people we were - frightened, desperate, alone. We changed. We survived. And we did it together.
*You shall indulge their ancient follies no longer. A new church will rise; united, in your image, and blessed with the blood of the faithless.*
Of course, I haven't clarified with my students that the orb is no longer a threat. The legend of my explosive capabilities is an excellent means of controlling a classroom. Too good, if anything.
Good thing for me, I'd learned every goristro's weakness: they're dumb as bugbears on a bender. Throw something shiny, and they'll chase it.
Kiss him.
The old masonry of Moonrise Towers and Reithwin have been repurposed into new homes, and the land is rich with harvests and bountiful trees. Nature and civilisation are in harmony, stronger together.
My next mark's the most challenging yet, or so she says. I don't know much more, only that it's no demon - but a devil.
It is good to see you.
Club
Know that I love them best.
Blood Splatter 'Splat!'
Duty... All my life, I've travelled in its slipstream, not once questioning its path. In its service, I came here. And now, in its service, I leave.
I'm not worried in the slightest. I've needed this.
So modest after achieving so much? What's the point in being a hero if you just brush off the praise?
I wish I could be there in person. It is good to see you.
Ah, there it is. That is what I have been missing.
You haven't mentioned the Council of Four since you disbanded it.
Halsin's commune is lovely, especially this time of year.
Yes, I'm certain it is. As for you, well, I've heard congratulations are in order.
You are correct, no doubt. I have seen more terrors than wonders since we last met.
Good thing I never touch foot in the Hells without my companion wolf Lily.
I know, but I need to be here for Lae'zel.
Time we spoke with Elminster, I think. If we're lucky, we might catch him between courses.
And I know that this is not what you are saying, my friend.
With that, I'm afraid my spell is waning. Is there anything else you need of me, before I blink out of existence?
Thou brought joy to the dark of her last hours. It was the greatest gift thou could have given.
Generic Voice 5 Male
Open Hand Monk
Thou searchest for the strongest warrior amongst thine band. Lae'zel, who ascended to the stars.
I recall you have quite a few young wards to care for - nine wagons of them, wasn't it?
Error logging in.
Fantastic idea - it'll suit the whole affair perfectly.
Now, what do you want?
Fear not. My heart has survived far crueller partings, and lived to tell the tale.
I noticed the scent of sulphur. It's awful - is that you?
I have explored the harshest lands of the Sword Coast, piercing the hearts of the lich queen's countless assassins.
I suppose that's my way of saying I miss you. Tonight, I toast not just the people we've become -
I've slain more than githyanki. Tall mouthers living in the Trollclaws, ogres roaming the Forlorn Hills...
I would kill for a glass of Ulaver wine.
What's happened to your father? Did Mizora make good on her promise?
Then you're right in your element.
Bohemian
It's been tough, but at least I'm there with Karlach.
I'm so grateful for the time we had together.
And renounce your own god? I'm flattered.
Are there any creatures blinder than the githyanki?
We've retrieved a silver sword, the sort worthy of a gith warrior.
Fuck Baldur's Gate. Fuck Avernus. They're mine now.
To turn away citizens of the realm is to be an enemy of the realm.
There you are, Lae'zel! A bit less corporeal than I imagined, but looking splendid all the same!
Heh. I was as surprised as anyone when Orpheus spoke the order.
One day, sir, I'll convince you to put your roots down back where they belong. Among your books, near your fire, in view of your dear friend Tara.
*You are calm. You are you. You can do this.*
It's meal time, Adventurer!
Selûne's Ire
Performance
Enjoy the revelry of the day; thou deservest at least that much.
You should come to one of my parties - it will definitely take your mind off work.
A blessing, no less? Well isn't that just darling?
I'll save the bloodiest sarth scalp from the heap, just for you.
One day, I may return to Menzoberranzan, as a conqueror or as a sacrifice. But my fight is elsewhere for now.
Of course. The city's prodigal son, returned as a saviour, and yoked to a devil - it is such a perfect satire, who could help but laugh?
I've been out seeing the world, visiting cities charming dignitaries, and making friends up and down the Sword Coast.
Though thou wert drawn far apart in the months after the collapse of the Absolute.
No Jaw attachment
Your domain will come to you as you settle into divinity. I can't wait to see what you'll become.
Only a true illithid can cast Karsus' Compulsion and defeat the Netherbrain. Use the Supreme Tadpole to transform before continuing.
I did miss you, you know. There is a sense of loneliness that comes with power.
So do as you must, and see where the path takes you. My door and heart will both remain open to you, always.

[A small extract from a self-published polemic tabloid. A note is attached at the top.]

I will NOT be SILENCED! - E

-----
NEEDLING WITH ETTVARD
Friends, Baldurians, my people. Consider our loss. Our lauded and benevolent patriars - maimed. Our great upper city libraries - demolished. The very beating heart of our great city - the right to speak freely - dead upon the cobbles. Do you not SEE, my friends - Lord Gortash, formerly our greatest bulwark against the Absolute, is now smeared as a collaborator? His allies and colleagues tossed aside! Former publications of repute turning to censorious farces! I ask you -

[The pamphlet continues in much the same fashion.]
What of those with evil ambitions? Do you encourage them too?
I'm sure we could widen the door frame - imagine being able to cuddle an owlbear on a cold night.
This artefact contains the key to our freedom. It is not for the lich queen to take!
Why, Master Dekarios, I had no idea you would continue to stoke the fires of adventure. I commend you - as shall the children, once they hear of your exploits. Thank you.
You seem... happy. Are you sure you haven't been drinking blood?
Do you ever miss walking in the sun?
Me too, my love. See you soon.
*Perhaps Mystra will recognise you for your humility, perhaps not.*
Regale Halsin with tales of your tranquil life with your family and coterie of animals.
I've never been more sure. Ready when you are.
Launch Protocol: Hellfire Barrage
Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate
*An invitation your burgeoning curiosity cannot allow you to decline.*
I could have told you that.
Zombie
True enough. I still hunt monsters, protect the coast - but now, I do it on my terms.
War Pick +1
Zaerith Menyar-Ag-Gith.
I will think on it, but I make no promises.
I love you.
Beckoning
The day I shave this beard, Tara, is that day I shave you. For both of our sakes, I hope it never comes.
And if Menyar-Ag-Gith refuses, we carry on. Gravity pulls us in but one direction.
Astarion spoke to Raphael while we were sleeping. The devil agreed to help Astarion if we kill his old enemy in the Temple of Shar.
I never got your name.
Even Kagha may yet find true balance, thanks to her influence.
I will liberate you from your puppet-master. Ch'mar, zal'a Vlaakith!
Ah, there it is. That is what I have been missing.
Tonight, time stands still for us. Make the most of it, Gale.
How about a statue of me, but in my night clothes.
City Landmark
Illmater
It was an accident. I promise I'll put it back.
I will join you both, and we will slay the traitorous lich queen.
Thy life. Yes.
Gale, get you back to Waterdeep. Our archives don't need a bookworm infestation.
I had a feeling you might.
Roaring E
I can't imagine hugs are all that common in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace... may I?
And when you're done, we can get back to enjoying forever together.
A veritable bloodbath, you say? How could I refuse, darling?
Our current plan is to get in, grab a smith, and force him to fix old rusty - or maybe give me a brand new model that can live outside Avernus.
They can expect whatever they like. I wouldn't change a thing.
I really thought there was more to you. That you were better than other people.
My love, my heart. Breathe deep - can you smell it?
I'll never forget its howls as it sank into the magma.
I can imagine. Hopefully our humble little gathering is up to your measure.

To Whom it May Concern,

Withers gave me this address and said I could consider writing. Well, I considered it.

Return address included.

Best,

Barcus Wroot
How's your father? You've been in good spirits since your latest visit.
Deep down, I knew you'd recognise me. You're a fellow bard, after all! Aha! What can I do you for?
Kiss him.
Braced Gate
I didn't ask earlier - what were you doing in the Fugue Plane?
Yes, if anyone can laugh in the face of damnation, she certainly can. You are lucky to have her.
Withers is hiring bards? Glad to see my money put to good use.
It's been wonderful to see you again. Reminds me of old times around the campfire. We used to think becoming a mind flayer was a fate worse than death.
What else? Helping, whether I ask for it or no.
Have you come seeking a statement for your next tell-all?

I'm not much for leaving my city, but it does gladden a girl's heart to be asked to the ball - so I'll thank you for that much.

In my place, accept a few casks of a fine vintage that managed to roll their way down from the Upper City in all the commotion. The rebuilding has given rise to many such happy opportunities - worth discussing over a more civilised drink in my Guildhall, if you find yourself at a loose end.

Enjoy the muck, and see if you can get the High Harper to sing - you won't be disappointed.
N.F.
If anyone can survive Avernus twice, it's you.
Make sure it is the good one.
Well the gnomes call him Nebelun - that's his 'true name', surely?
Reach from beyond to a mortal creature, sending shivers down its spine.
Can't keep away from me, I see? I don't blame you.
Why she chose to take one such as yourself as a retainer is beyond me.
I don't believe this. You're really gone?
I'm assuming your life has been anything but dull?
Hardly anything new for either of you. He'll love it, I'm sure.
We're fighting in the Blood Wars, Gale. No one expects us to have dressed for the occasion.
You seem... happy. Are you sure you haven't been drinking blood?
Try to wound me all you like, but I'm so much better than he ever was.
Of course I'll join you. My duty is to vanquish any and all dangers to the Sword Coast.
You couldn't have tidied yourself up a bit for the celebration?
You managed to drag me to the only bookshop in Avernus, Gale. I think they'll believe that.
Inherited Skills with Expertise
Trying to escape bad memories?
Gale is his own man, Tara.
Boo had a moment to lick himself clean, but there is a little too much of Minsc to cover.
My story is yours now, Karlach. It may never be written in the githyanki slates, but it will be legendary all the same.
Come to gloat, Mizora? We found a letter claiming Ravengard died.
I shouldn't have let you come here. This isn't going to be easy, you know. Zariel's going to come at us with everything she's got.
So, I've settled for teaching the art of illusion. Magic to confound the senses, to render the impossible into reality, and to allow expression of that most magical attribute of all - imagination.
You will make the very best of Harpers, Bhaalspawn. Take this. The old harp of harmony. You know its song.
*Your curdled mind is eager for their sleep, so you can strike with the death-dream.*
If Cazador progresses the ritual [1] more times, he will sacrifice all the spawn and ascend!
Give it a little while - and your fears will be long forgotten.
Bhaal
Weave-Touched Robe
Invite [1] friends.
I'm told you carry an artefact most cherished.
Let's go.
*Karlach's heart can take the strain of leaving Avernus for a few short hours, but it might burst with joy to see those friends again.*
You were in a cell? What for?
Something lively that encourages dancing would be perfect.
That faulty ticker of yours can be fixed, I'm quite certain. But the outcome lies in your hands, not mine. Throw a prayer or two my way, though, and I'll gladly provide some encouragement.
Is this just a ploy to read the tomes on Myth Drannor the Twilight Hall keeps, which cannot be accessed by those not sworn?
Shoot an eye ray that deals immense damage.
Though not half so bad as the one he'll take, once we tell Dame Aylin of his plans.
Turn-Based Mode
Thinking about taking over the world. But this time doing it my way.
I was starting to think you'd never ask...
I've turned my mind to political concerns. We seek a powerful ally: the githzerai.
A tenday of good wine, good music - and the best company: yours.
Ah, and you wish Minsc to come and tell your students of the adventurer's road? An honour!
Someone is editing a character - unconfirmed changes will not be saved.
Even now, I struggle to put the feeling into words. It was like exhaling for the first time, after holding my breath for so very long.
Did you hear that, Boo? Minsc has won the wager!
There's no servitude - the illithid is my ally.
... well. Of course he has. I suppose I shall have to add a visit to their quarters to an already long list.
My mucous membranes are self-cleaning. Thank you for noticing.
High Hall
Orange Maple Leaf
What have you been doing since we last met?
Selûne
Perhaps. But they may crave some more excitement.
Blue
The tadpole would have feasted on that impressive mind of yours if you hadn't fought so hard.
She hasn't dared flash her wings since we crushed the Netherbrain and freed the infected.
That's a poor tone to take with the God of Ambition.
Standing I
The wyrm is dead, but his spirit lives within me. I've pledged to follow in your footsteps!
I have too. Terribly.
Enjoy my presence while you can. I won't be staying long.
Eltan. Mizora is a devil; I am my father's son. Will you really trust her word over mine?
It's been tough, but at least I'm there with Karlach.
Ha! Well, it's a relief to know a friend is there for them, in your way.
Agh, sentiment. With the greatest affection - I can think of better ways to sour our stomachs.
The music's fine, uninvited guests are not. Who are you?
Intricately embroidered to the highest standards, these booties are the height of current Sword Coast fashion.
Call the dragons, Lae'zel. I will join you, and we will slay the traitorous lich queen.
I am yours. Come to me.
Speaking of your father, how is he holding up?
Now that I've settled in Baldur's Gate. My battles are few and far between.
I did at first, but then I realised - these shadows, this darkness - it's all part of me.
Letter from Nocturne
Careful. My acolytes won't take too kindly to that. Nor will I.
You are afraid of so many things, and it is that fear that keeps you true to yourself.
Exactly what someone who tried to usurp a goddess would say...
Flying
Arms Crossed
Quite the opposite. My 'funeral protocol' runs to several hours of riveting speeches, tributes, and instructions as to the beneficiaries of my various wizarding sundries.
Me neither. It's just like I dreamed of - a little house to call our own, teeming with animals, the flowers we sowed starting to bloom... and you there, at my side.
But I am glad to see you doing well. I'm glad to see us all doing well, in fact. Things turned out rather nicely in the end.
*Now you have a chance to say goodbye.*
I just wish we didn't have to go back.
Hold on. The great warrior Lae'zel on a diplomatic mission?
Trust me, Gale. This is a really atrocious idea.
Avernus is my hunting ground now - I've been putting my infernal powers to good use there.
My own son Jord has been wooed to their ranks. Already he plans crop cycles in Wyrm's Crossing.
Call the dragons, Lae'zel. I will join you, and we will slay the traitorous lich queen.
Now go on, before I change my mind.
Dirty Advantage
I was searching for a way to walk in the sun again. No luck yet, but I won't give up.
*He is, however, exhausted. He's had plenty of adventures without you.*
That's fair, Karlach. Come on, let's get out of here.
Devella, the principal investigator of the serial killings, was defeated. If we still want to find the Temple of Bhaal, we must take the lead in the investigation ourselves.
My blade is sharp as ever. But now, I wield it for a truly righteous cause.
Fire a cascade of magical broadheads and bodkin arrows upon nearby foes.
I've been enjoying life. Throwing parties, making connections, slowly amassing power...
No Chin attachment
I expect you'll have a few tales that will need to wait until they are older.
The world awaits your command. What is it to be?
